arcs.title: The Second Circle
arcs.summary: New arc, opening with the second waymarker pencilled on the ordnance chart at the head of an unnamed hollow, four miles north-northeast of the first. Steve's three-word margin note has not been fully disclosed. Christine has the access road. The Jeep's tank will need refilling. Day 2 should establish what the hollow is — a named local feature, a trail that someone else has mentioned, something spotted from the ridge today — and what additional preparation the table begins to accumulate. The departure window is not this weekend but is narrowing.
